description: Argo value-parameter vectors. Between tasks a value has exactly one spelling: canonical JSON when its canonical body is at most inlineLimit bytes, otherwise '@' followed by the canonical JSON reference to blobs/sha256/<hex>. Workflow inputs are inline JSON only and are canonicalized at the entry. Map item results use itemInlineLimit and an indexed envelope with value or ref. Hashes are SHA-256 over canonical JSON bytes, computed independently of the Go implementation.

cases.name: string whose canonical body is exactly the inline limit
string one byte above the inline limit is referenced
records above the inline limit are referenced
a workflow input is normalized to canonical JSON
a large workflow input is accepted inline
item result at the item inline limit stays inline
item result above the item inline limit is referenced
